dedupe_keys.name: machine learning based optimization of waste plastic pyrolysis parameters for maximum oil yield code and data

description: The research authors publish code and a curated 325-row dataset for predicting liquid-oil yield from waste-plastic pyrolysis. Zenodo provides a MIT-licensed archive. Six regression methods use feedstock composition and operating settings; the record describes support-vector and boosted-tree results and a SHAP analysis. A screening step searches feasible settings for high predicted yield. This model can supply a process-response component to recycling-facility and waste-to-energy scenario simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this code-and-data release. Coverage is the literature-derived experiments and studied operating range, not every industrial reactor or waste stream. A limitation is that the dataset is derived from supporting material to an earlier publication and its original rights should be checked separately. Predicted optimum yield is a model output, not a validated commercial-plant result. The archive was not downloaded and the cross-validation or optimisation was not repeated.
